title: Source-Bound Evidence for SWRD=2 Root History and SWRD=3 WRT Ownership

potential_update.behavior: rrpot = min(RDM-rdpot,RRI); when allowed, rdpot = rdpot + rrpot

actual_update.behavior: rr = min(RDM-rd,RRI), then stress/assimilation/oxygen conditions may reduce or suppress rr before rd = rd + rr

SWRD_1.behavior: actual and potential root depth are recalculated from DVS/RDTB/RDM

SWRD_3.behavior: actual root depth is recalculated from WRT and RLWTB; potential depth uses WRTPOT

findings: WRT can be initialized from WROOTTB(DVS) when adaptive roots, microscopic drought uptake, or oxygen physics needs root biomass.
WRT is updated as crop root biomass and GRRT/DRRT rates are derived from the WRT change.
WOFOST initializes s%wrt from biomass partitioning together with s%wst, s%wlv and s%wso.
WOFOST evolves s%wrt by root growth rate together with other organ biomass.
Actual WRT published to plant_interface is copied from s%wrt; potential WRTPOT is copied from potential WOFOST state.

WRT_broader_ownership.reason: Adding WRT only to satisfy root geometry would create a competing copy of crop biomass state once fixed-crop/WOFOST evolution is migrated.

state_shape_consequence.SWRD_2: use an extended state subtype carrying rd and rdpot
state_shape_consequence.SWRD_3: use base/common crop lifecycle plus a future authoritative biomass owner/view; do not allocate SWRD2 root history
